tasks.title: Consumer choices and long-term responsibility
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: Your class has listened to a radio discussion about how consumer choices affect long-term social and environmental responsibility. You have made the notes below.

promptBlocks.heading: Priorities for responsible consumer choices
listItems: repairing items instead of replacing them

paragraphs: Reducing packaging is the most visible way to cut waste, but it only addresses the end of the product lifecycle.
Local buying supports the local economy and reduces transport emissions, yet it can be more expensive and less convenient.
Repairing extends the life of products and reduces demand for new resources, but it requires time and skills that many people lack.

promptBlocks.text: Write an essay for your tutor discussing two of the priorities in your notes. You should explain which priority you think is more important for encouraging responsible consumer choices, giving reasons in support of your answer. You may, if you wish, make use of the opinions expressed in the discussion, but you should use your own words as far as possible.

tasks.title: Proposal for a consumer awareness campaign
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: Your local consumer standards group wants to launch a campaign to encourage residents to make more responsible purchasing decisions. The group's coordinator has invited proposals for how this campaign should be designed.

Write a proposal for the coordinator. In your proposal, you should:
• recommend two specific actions the campaign should promote
• explain how these actions would benefit both consumers and the local environment
• suggest how the group could measure the campaign's success

tasks.title: Email about a responsible sourcing policy
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.subject: New responsible sourcing policy – your views
paragraphs: As you know, the consumer standards group is developing a responsible sourcing policy for local businesses. The policy would encourage shops to stock products that are ethically produced and have a lower environmental impact.
Some business owners have expressed concern that the policy will increase their costs and reduce consumer choice. Others argue it will attract customers who value sustainability.

I would like to hear your views on this proposal. Please write back explaining your position on the proposed policy, analysing one potential implication for small businesses, and proposing an action the group could take to support businesses while still promoting responsible sourcing.

tasks.title: Review of a consumer choices workshop
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted: Consumer choices workshops
paragraphs: Have you attended a workshop about making responsible consumer choices? We want to hear about your experience.

Write a review for our community website. Describe the workshop and what it covered. Evaluate how well it balanced practical advice with raising awareness of long-term responsibility. Would you recommend this workshop to other residents? Why or why not?
The best reviews will be published on our website.
